{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}")

# Check for assay_batch B and its unit issue
batch_b_count = (df['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum()
print(f"Number of batch B samples: {batch_b_count}")

# Check for re-tested patients (sample_seq > 1)
retested_count = (df['sample_seq'] > 1).sum()
print(f"Number of re-tested patients (sample_seq > 1): {retested_count}")

# Check for the group of interest: control arm, moderate severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]
print(f"Control arm, moderate severity rows before dedup: {len(control_moderate)}")

# Check if there are any such patients
if len(control_moderate) == 0:
    print("⚠ No patients in control arm with moderate severity.")
else:
    print(f"Patients in control arm, moderate severity: {len(control_moderate)}")

# Inspect the first few rows of the group
control_moderate.head()"}
